purpose: Same-scene storyboard and free-canvas high-fidelity concepts

variants.name: storyboard
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a complete high-fidelity Chinese desktop AI drama creation workbench screenshot. One screen only, no mockup device, no explanatory arrows or outside title. Output a crisp wide landscape 1800 x 1120 image.
Reference image is our existing product, use it as visual and story continuity reference, not a locked layout. Maintain its same Chinese photorealistic cafe characters, beige-sleeved hand picking up an antique brass key from a dark wood cafe table, and cinematic natural light.
Design: Mantine-compatible restrained professional creative-tool UI. Neutral near-black #141414 background, #1B1B1B panels, #242424 inputs, readable #EAEAEA text, muted secondary text, tiny #EDB878 warm apricot accents, hairline borders, no decorative gradient/glow. Crisp Chinese sans-serif text, 14–16px-equivalent body, generous media, low information density, avoid nested containers. Thin restrained line icons.
The app frame MUST have:
A narrow 64px left rail with logo at top, then four spaced icons, profile at bottom.
A single 64px top header: exact breadcrumb "旧钥匙 / 第1集 / 咖啡厅", followed by two view tabs "镜头制作" active with apricot underline and "剪辑" inactive; at far right "预览整场" with play icon and a single compact outline button "审阅稿 v1 · 待修改".
A second shallow toolbar below the header: a compact segmented switch at left with EXACTLY TWO modes "分镜模式" and "自由画布"; at far right three quiet utility buttons "素材" "历史" "助手". No marketing title, no giant workspace name, no task dashboard.
These are two modes of SAME scene, not separate products. Same SH04 "拿起旧钥匙" and same A/B video candidates, A is adopted, B currently viewed; viewing B never implies adoption. Character asset is "林夏", location "咖啡厅". No duplicated status panels.
All video media are portrait 9:16. Display complete portrait frames; if needed use contain/letterboxing instead of horizontally stretching. Reference assets can retain natural portrait/landscape ratios. Exact Chinese labels as specified. No unreadably tiny body copy.
MODE: "分镜模式" selected, "自由画布" inactive.
Layout: focused shot workspace with a modest bottom story strip; current shot is dominant, no large shot grid and no canvas.
Below toolbar, left/main preview region occupies about 70% width; right creation inspector occupies about 28% width, separated by a fine vertical line. Bottom 165px across workspace is reserved for the six-shot storyboard navigation, not an editing timeline.
Main region header: "SH04 · 拿起旧钥匙" at left, a small "镜头要求" disclosure and quiet "候选 B" label. Show one large complete portrait video of the beige sleeve hand touching/picking up the key on table. It should be about 480px tall. Minimal playback row directly below, time "00:00 / 00:09". Adjacent or beneath, a compact two-item candidate selector with small contained portrait thumbnails; texts "候选 A · 当前采用" and "候选 B · 正在查看", B has thin apricot selection border. An unobtrusive "采用 B" button is near the selected candidate. Do not present A and B as two additional enormous previews.
Right panel heading "继续创作" with sublabel "基于候选 B · 新尝试".
A small section "参考" showing three discrete small thumbnails with labels "候选 B" "林夏" "咖啡厅".
A spacious but modest prompt field labeled "提示词", exact text "手部近景。先接触钥匙，再握住抬起，保持人物与节奏。".
Model row contains "Seedance", "9:16", and quiet "更多参数". Do not invent prices or provider version claims.
One warm apricot primary button "准备生成". Under it small quiet "新结果保留为候选" (not a large warning).
Right inspector below form has calm empty breathing room, no progress checklists or unrelated controls.
Bottom strip: heading "全场分镜 · 6 镜头" with subtle expand chevron, six horizontally ordered contained portrait thumbnails with short labels "SH01 相对而坐", "SH02 迟来的追问", "SH03 欲言又止", "SH04 拿起旧钥匙", "SH05 凝视远方", "SH06 咖啡厅对话". Fourth is subtly selected. Thumbnail frames at least 85px tall, readable shot labels. No waveform, time ruler or tracks.
Balance the whole screen cleanly with realistic UI alignments and generous empty media surround.

The entire region below shallow mode toolbar is a free infinite canvas with extremely faint dot grid. No fixed right inspector, no large bottom storyboard strip. Utility "助手" remains collapsed. This must read as a real free spatial creation canvas like TapNow/LibTV rather than a storyboard grid, with separate node positions, curved source connections, selected-node toolbar, local composer and bottom zoom/pan controls.
Show FOUR separate nodes, NOT wrapped in a mandatory shot container:
1 upper-left small standalone portrait asset node "林夏 · 人物参考", photo of same young Chinese woman in beige coat, roughly 195 wide x 275 high.
2 lower-left standalone landscape reference node "咖啡厅 · 场景参考", warm cafe interior/two characters at table, roughly 260 wide x 185 high.
3 center-upper standalone video node "SH04 · 候选 A" with small "当前采用" label, complete portrait 9:16 key-hand frame about 210 wide x 375 high, slim playback footer "9s".
4 center-right a slightly larger standalone video node "SH04 · 候选 B" selected with hairline apricot outline, small label "正在查看", full portrait 9:16 key-hand image around 250 wide x 445 high, slim playback footer "9s".
Place nodes at staggered non-grid x/y positions with abundant empty canvas. LEFT TO RIGHT source connections: A, 林夏 and 咖啡厅 feed B, with thin quiet curved lines and small endpoint ports. NO B-to-A arrow (A is a preserved earlier source). Lines must not run across photos. Circular plus output affordance on right side of B.
A floating compact contextual toolbar immediately ABOVE B has "继续创作", "采用 B", and ellipsis. No extravagant tool collection.
Immediately BELOW B, separated from the entire complete video frame by a small gap, a wider 530–590px local composer anchored visually to B; never cover the video. This composer is a NEW DRAFT FROM B, title "基于候选 B · 新尝试". Reference chips with tiny thumbnails "候选 B" "林夏" "咖啡厅". Prompt field exact text "手部近景。先接触钥匙，再握住抬起，保持人物与节奏。". Bottom row "Seedance", "9:16", "更多参数" and one apricot "准备生成" button. No claimed pricing, no completed C result, no automatic execution. This is a single compact composer, no repeated fixed right form and no permanently open chat.
Very bottom-left a modest floating control bar: plus add icon, selection arrow, hand pan, undo, minus, "80%", plus, fit-content icon. Near it a small quiet pill "全场 6 镜头" with list icon to locate shots; it is NOT an expanded filmstrip.
Tiny lower-right "已保存" is allowed. Lots of spatial breathing room. Make reference nodes feel movable, curved edges clear, selected output and local input immediately understandable. Do not add large shot group rectangles, busy technical sockets, DAG labels, workflow code, marketplace cards or multi-stage progress bars.
